The Ancient Science of Ashta Koota Matchmaking

In the Vedic matrimonial tradition, marriage is considered a sacred cosmic bond (Samskara) that connects two souls across multiple lifetimes. Kundli Milan is an intricate astrological evaluation comparing the birth charts of prospective partners, centered around the Ashta Koota (8 Criteria) scoring system comprising a maximum of 36 Gunas (Points).

Breakdown of the 8 Sacred Kootas

Koota Name Points Key Psychological & Spiritual Significance
1. Varna 1 Point Spiritual and ego alignment between partners.
2. Vashya 2 Points Mutual attraction, devotion, and magnetic influence.
3. Tara 3 Points Destiny harmony, health, and mutual well-being.
4. Yoni 4 Points Biological compatibility and intimate sexual harmony.
5. Graha Maitri 5 Points Mental compatibility and friendship between Moon sign lords.
6. Gana 6 Points Temperamental nature (Deva, Manushya, Rakshasa).
7. Bhakoot 7 Points Emotional growth, family prosperity, and longevity of marriage.
8. Nadi 8 Points Genetic and physiological compatibility, progeny health.

What Do the Guna Scores Mean?

  • Below 18 Points: Not recommended in classical texts due to fundamental friction in temperament or Nadi energy.
  • 18 to 24 Points: Average compatibility. Acceptable if planetary lords and Navamsha charts (D9) are supportive.
  • 25 to 32 Points: Highly auspicious matchmaking with strong harmony, mutual respect, and prosperity.
  • 33 to 36 Points: Rare celestial match conferring exceptional devotion, long-lasting peace, and spiritual growth.

Understanding Nadi Dosha & Manglik Dosha

Two critical checks in any Vedic matchmaking are Nadi Dosha (when both partners share the exact same Nadi) and Manglik Dosha (placement of Mars in 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th house). Classical Jyotish provides numerous cancellation exceptions (Dosha Parihara), such as different Nakshatra padas or when Mars is placed in its own sign of Aries or Scorpio.

"True compatibility goes beyond numbers; when mutual respect, compassion, and divine timing align, every relationship flourishes."
